questions.prompt: What service does the organization provide to its customers?
Where does the system run (cloud providers, hosting, regions)?
Where should people report a security issue (an email address or page)?
Which outside providers operate part of the system for you (for example a cloud host)? Separate them with semicolons.
Do customers rely on commitments about uptime or recovery (include Availability)?
Do you hold information customers expect you to keep confidential (include Confidentiality)?
Do customers rely on your processing being complete and accurate, such as calculations or transactions (include Processing Integrity)?
Do you collect personal information directly from individuals and make privacy commitments to them (include Privacy)?
Does the organization build or change the software that delivers the service?
Does the system store customer data?
Does the organization operate an office or facility that houses system components or customer data?
Will your personnel policy require background checks before granting access?
